description: Curated Offline Maven CVE Database for Hermetic Auditing (Constitution Principle IV)

entries.title: Denial of Service via Unrestricted Entity Expansion in SnakeYAML
entries.description: SnakeYAML versions prior to 2.0 are vulnerable to Denial of Service via stack overflow during unvalidated recursive entity parsing.
entries.remediationGuidance: Upgrade org.yaml:snakeyaml to version 2.0 or higher in pom.xml.

entries.title: Denial of Service via Deeply Nested JSON Objects in Jackson-databind
entries.description: Jackson-databind before 2.15.0 mishandles stack limits during recursive deserialization of deeply nested JSON structures.

entries.title: Path Traversal in Spring MVC Resource Handler
entries.description: Spring MVC versions prior to 6.0.14 can be susceptible to path traversal via malformed URI requests in static resource handlers.

entries.title: Serialization Vulnerability in Logback Receiver
entries.description: Logback versions before 1.3.12 / 1.4.12 contain a deserialization flaw in SocketReceiver allowing remote arbitrary code execution.

entries.title: HTTP/2 Header Denial of Service in Apache Tomcat
entries.description: Apache Tomcat embedded core before 10.1.19 does not properly limit HTTP/2 continuation frames, leading to denial of service.

entries.title: Remote Code Execution via JNDI in Log4j (Log4Shell)
entries.description: Apache Log4j2 versions up to 2.17.0 are vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via unauthenticated JNDI lookup expressions.
entries.remediationGuidance: Upgrade org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core to 2.17.1 or higher immediately.
